name: V-shaped selling pressure overhang
note: The Grinblatt-Han turnover-weighted cost-basis distribution with the ABSOLUTE value taken inside the sum, so a name whose holders are half deep in gains and half deep in losses scores high while the signed capital-gains measure scores it near zero. Weights w_{t-n} = V_{t-n} * prod(1 - V) are built exactly as in the paper but maintained recursively (every stored weight decays by (1-V_t) each bar), and the turnover V is proxied from OHLCV as turn_c * volume / its own rolling mean, capped at vmax - single-symbol bars carry no shares outstanding. Short a rally running into a top-pct_cut overhang, buy a rally running into a bottom-pct_cut one. The paper's +3%-over-5-sessions rally trigger is expressed as rally_atr * ATR over rally_win bars, because a fixed 3% is unreachable on the intraday bars this harness runs and would make the family fire on leveraged names only.
source: Synthesis extending the Grinblatt & Han construction (NBER w8734) with the V-shaped selling schedule of Ben-David & Hirshleifer, 'Are Investors Really Reluctant to Realize Their Losses?', Review of Financial Studies 25(8), 2012, 2485-2532 (cited by the idea's author from background knowledge, not verified in their session). The VSP statistic and the trade construction are the idea author's own. Related: An, Ang, Bali & Cakici on V-shaped net selling propensity.

def family_init(ctx):
    from bisect import insort, bisect_left
    bars = ctx.bars
    N = len(bars)
    cl = [float(b["c"]) for b in bars]
    vo = [float(b.get("v") or 0.0) for b in bars]

    vwin = int(ctx.p.vwin)
    turn_c = float(ctx.p.turn_c)
    vmax = float(ctx.p.vmax)
    lb = int(ctx.p.lb)
    prune = float(ctx.p.prune)
    min_lb = int(ctx.p.min_lb)

    vsp = [None] * N
    prices = []
    qs = []
    D = 1.0
    vsum = 0.0
    for j in range(N):
        vsum += vo[j]
        n = j + 1
        if j >= vwin:
            vsum -= vo[j - vwin]
            n = vwin
        mv = vsum / n
        V = (turn_c * vo[j] / mv) if mv > 0.0 else turn_c
        if V > vmax:
            V = vmax
        elif V < 1e-6:
            V = 1e-6
        D *= (1.0 - V)
        q = V / D
        prices.append(cl[j])
        qs.append(q)
        if q > 1e100:
            D *= q
            f = q
            for k in range(len(qs)):
                qs[k] /= f
        qb = qs[-1]
        while len(qs) > lb or (len(qs) > 2 and qs[0] < prune * qb):
            qs.pop(0)
            prices.pop(0)
        c0 = cl[j]
        if c0 <= 0.0 or len(qs) < min_lb:
            continue
        s1 = 0.0
        s2 = 0.0
        for k in range(len(qs)):
            wt = qs[k]
            s1 += wt
            d = c0 - prices[k]
            s2 += wt * (d if d >= 0.0 else -d)
        if s1 > 0.0:
            vsp[j] = s2 / (s1 * c0)

    hist = int(ctx.p.hist)
    minh = int(ctx.p.min_hist)
    cut = float(ctx.p.pct_cut) / 100.0
    lo_t = [None] * N
    hi_t = [None] * N
    sl = []
    win = []
    for j in range(N):
        x = vsp[j]
        if x is None:
            continue
        insort(sl, x)
        win.append(x)
        if len(win) > hist:
            old = win.pop(0)
            del sl[bisect_left(sl, old)]
        m = len(sl)
        if m >= minh:
            lo_t[j] = sl[int(cut * (m - 1))]
            hi_t[j] = sl[int((1.0 - cut) * (m - 1))]
    ctx.vsp = ctx.series(vsp, "vsp")
    ctx.vsp_lo = ctx.series(lo_t, "vsp_lo")
    ctx.vsp_hi = ctx.series(hi_t, "vsp_hi")


def signal(ctx, i):
    x = ctx.vsp[i]
    if x is None:
        return 0
    lo_ = ctx.vsp_lo[i]
    hi_ = ctx.vsp_hi[i]
    if lo_ is None or hi_ is None:
        return 0
    rw = int(ctx.p.rally_win)
    if i - rw < 0:
        return 0
    a = ctx.a[i]
    if a is None or a <= 0.0:
        return 0
    if (ctx.c[i] - ctx.c[i - rw]) < float(ctx.p.rally_atr) * a:
        return 0
    if x >= hi_:
        return -1
    if x <= lo_:
        return 1
    return 0


def exit_signal(ctx, i):
    if not ctx.positions:
        return False
    e = min(p["entry_i"] for p in ctx.positions)
    return (i - e) >= int(ctx.p.hold)
